Both hands down. Knees bent.

As if I was groveling at his feet. Very disgraceful. Hone do. Let it look disgraceful; who was asking about appearances now?

The more I struggled, the more the pain came back. It had been settling, and now it was up again. That could also go to hell.

I raised myself.
...Legs wouldn't hold.

Achha. Upper body, then. I forced strength into my stiff arms and made them support me.

There was Suzukawa. Still standing with both hands raised, gazing at the ceiling, fully intoxicated by his own importance—or that was how it looked from here.

Bhai, were you an idiot only?

Both hands hit the floor. The recoil lifted me a little.

Bas, enough. Fold the legs under. Off my knees, onto the soles of my feet.

My weight pulled the wound open. That wild electric pain came again.

Swallow. Teeth into it, break it, send it down.

Straighten the knees. More weight. More pain. Ignore.

I stood.
In front of Suzukawa.
In front of my enemy.

Elbow bent. Arm close to my side. Draw it back.

Even now he apparently couldn't understand what I was starting. Only that doubtful look coming down at me.

Left foot forward. The knee shook with pain. Seh le. Bear it.

Fist tight. Hips turning with everything I had—

I punched him.

Final bomb. Direct hit.

Cracks ran all over the warrior.
...No, it looked like that.

Iron body swaying, shaking. The man inside was shaken, and the armor was telling me.

Anger.
Blind, mad fury.

Then protect Konatsu and Tadayasu. Then get out of here.

Haan, fine. Just thinking it was enough to make my head go.

Kyon? Kaise?

Why again?

Why were you standing in front of me? Back toward us, as if you would protect us?

How were you doing that!?
